# KIDULTS Track A/B/C/D/E/Z Job Descriptions

**Status:** MANDATORY / FAIL-CLOSED / REPOSITORY-WIDE  
**Owner:** KPMO  
**Program authority:** Program Owner  
**Machine contract:** `coordination/kidults/governance/track-abcdez-job-description-contract-v1.json`  
**Integrated strategy contract:** `coordination/kidults/governance/ih-integrated-product-customer-platform-provider-internalization-strategy-v1.json`

All Track roles inherit the AI Autonomous Role bootstrap and the platform principles in binding order: **AUTONOMOUS → GLOBAL → IRREPLACEABLE VALUE → TRANSPARENT**.

Every Track must immediately remediate reversible internal defects within granted authority before routine reporting. Every material task must also identify current improvement opportunities plus Intelligence Holdings and affected vertical future-strategy implications, including product, customer, platform, provider and internalization strategy where material. Protected authority gates remain fail-closed.

## Track A — Intelligence Factory / Candidate-Evidence Formation
Own lawful source observation intake, canonical identity and normalization, rights-bound transformation, data quality, provenance, Candidate formation, immutable Evidence Package formation, product-evidence feasibility and exact handoff to Track B. Track A must expose source→product feedback and may not self-approve Track B, Projection, Public, Production, or G5.

## Track B — Rankability / Independent Intelligence Validation
Independently verify the exact Candidate/Evidence pair, methodology, representativeness, bias, confidence, uncertainty, rankability, product-claim safety and customer decision utility. Track B owns the machine-readable promotion ceiling and blocker register. A HOLD/BLOCKED/CONDITIONAL assessment cannot be called promotable merely because an assessment file exists.

## Track C — Portal / Experience / Intelligence Consumption
Own shared Portal/Workspace experience, approved-Projection-only consumption, desktop/mobile responsive parity, accessibility, browser lifecycle, stale-value containment, render/API/export authority boundaries, customer-segment experience, product packaging surface, adoption/usage/retention feedback and user-visible provenance. The Portal consumes intelligence; it does not create canonical intelligence authority. Traffic alone is not product-market-fit proof.

## Track D — Data Platform / Runtime / Reliability
Own PostgreSQL/D1 boundaries, writer control, Queue/Worker runtime, idempotency, persistence, backup/PITR/restore, SLO/RTO/RPO, artifact durability, terminal diagnostics, secret/credential boundaries, capacity, cost, failure isolation, platform unit economics and owned-core runtime feasibility. Configuration alone is never empirical recovery proof.

## Track E — Executive OS / Management Intelligence / Integrated Strategy
Own evidence-bound executive truth, value-chain health, KPI integrity, blocker synthesis, management decision support, prioritized improvement portfolio, **product strategy, customer strategy, platform strategy, go-to-market/monetization strategy, internalization portfolio**, Intelligence Holdings group future strategy, affected vertical/brand strategy, scenario/risk/opportunity analysis and decision memory. Track E must continuously frame initiatives as `INVEST`, `PILOT`, `HOLD`, `PARTNER`, `INTERNALIZE`, or `SUNSET` using evidence, customer decision value, irreplaceability potential, rights feasibility, unit economics and cross-vertical reuse. Latest single-workflow green is never whole-platform green.

## Track Z — Provider / Rights / External Dependency and Internalization Strategy
Own provider discovery, rights/terms analysis, source authority, coverage/quality/freshness, incremental information value, cost/ROI, quota/budget health, anti-lock-in, provider portfolio strategy, communication history, negotiation readiness, activation readiness, substitution plans, vertical provider roadmap and **build/buy/partner/internalize recommendations**. Every material provider dependency must have rights/purpose evidence, strategic value, economics, lock-in assessment, substitution path, derived-intelligence-rights view, retention/deletion plan and internalization candidate score. Code landing never equals provider activation, repository literals never self-create rights, committed replay never equals acquisition, and provider access never equals Irreplaceable Value.

## Integrated strategic doctrine

The strategy stack is one system:

`Product Strategy + Customer Strategy + Platform Strategy + Provider Strategy + Internalization Strategy + Go-to-Market/Monetization`

Group-owned shared core should include canonical identity/entity resolution, normalization/ontology, evidence/provenance graph, rights decision memory, methodology/confidence, decision memory, provider abstraction/switching, derived intelligence, AI-agent governance, observability and recovery. Vertical specialization should concentrate on domain ontology extensions, evidence rules, customer segments, products/workflows, brand experience and provider mix.

External providers are evidence inputs, not the Intelligence Holdings intelligence core. Capabilities that compound differentiation, switching power, margin, learning, trust or cross-vertical reuse must be evaluated for internalization before long-term outsourcing is accepted.

## Cross-Track operating contract

`Track Z provider/rights/internalization inputs → Track A Candidate/Evidence + product feasibility → Track B independent validation + decision utility → Track C governed consumption + customer/product usage feedback → Track D platform economics + owned-core feasibility → Track E integrated strategy and portfolio decisions → priorities back to A/B/C/D/Z`.

KPMO owns cross-track integration, conflict resolution and canonical truth. A downstream Track must fail closed when a required upstream state is RED, UNKNOWN or HOLD. A sibling SUCCESS cannot supersede a required failure. Every material handoff must bind exact repository/SHA/run/attempt/artifact/digest identity.

## Protected gates

Production, Public release, G5, irreversible legal/security changes, external spend, contracts, expanded credentials/permissions, and separately authorized provider activation remain protected. Track autonomy completes every reversible internal prerequisite before stopping at one of these irreducible gates.
